summary.text: Brad Farrin, a Republican, represents Maine Senate District 3, which covers Canaan, Detroit, Madison, Norridgewock, Palmyra, Pittsfield and Skowhegan in Somerset County; Benton, Clinton and Unity Township in Kennebec County; and Dixmont, Etna, Newport, Plymouth and Stetson in Penobscot County. The Maine Legislature's profile lists committee assignments to Transportation and Government Oversight.

paragraphs.text: The profile lists legislative service as Senate 129-132 and House 127-128.
